Design and launch notes
  • All three concepts retain the pre-form and two valuation routes.
  • Joe is shown as Head of Property Management. The design does not promise he will personally conduct sales valuations.
  • The form illustrates a proposed follow-up journey. Confirm the wording and current team details with the client.
  • Review ratings, testimonials and personal quotes are intentionally not invented. A verified branch review can be added beside the action after approval.
  • For a branch campaign, load the relevant local people. For the generic page, choose the local team once the property location is known, or use an accurate group team introduction.
  • Test completed, confirmed valuation requests and pre-form progression by device. These designs are test hypotheses, not guaranteed conversion improvements.
  • The HTML has no analytics, network requests or lead submission. Photos, fonts and background are embedded.
